status: FIT PROTOTYPE - CONNECTOR SAMPLE NOT MEASURED
coordinate_system: mm; x across port, y inward from flange front reference plane, z above motherboard top; top view has flange towards negative y; male pin 1 is at positive x

motherboard.verification: Nominal manufacturer replacement drawings; verify target motherboard revision and case

pcb.finish: ENIG preferred; finish is a manufacturer order choice

connector_sample_assumptions.note: Only flange reference size/centres and contact grid are sourced; rear body, solder cups, thickness and shape are illustrative pending selected solder-cup part

holder.nut_thread_requirement: Prototype defaults use M3 captive nuts and jackposts with M3 male rear stems / 4-40 UNC female cable-facing threads. HARTING 09670009924 is a candidate, not a frozen BOM item. Match actual nut dimensions and mounting stem; no assumption of M3.5.
holder.note: FIT PROTOTYPE. Solid printed base; only two integrated mounting feet reach motherboard Z0. The rest retains Z0.60 clearance. No separate anchor shims. Solder-cup connector, material, print fit and insertion strength require physical trials.
holder.anchor_assembly_note: Insert M3 screws upwards with an insulating washer beneath each head and the motherboard; fit nuts directly on the supported adapter-PCB SHIELD mounting pads. Verify flat seating and underside clearances. No default top washer and no separate printed foot shims.
holder.shell_relief_note: Shallow top recesses under dedicated J4 shell-bond wire holes clear pre-soldered fillets. Route insulated shell wires above PCB, clear of signal pins and cap latches.
holder.ground_wire_note: Right integrated foot has an outward-open 1.20mm wire groove, Z0..1.00, beginning at X24.00 on the original shell-pad annulus. Pre-solder the deliberate ground lead to the motherboard shell pad, route the insulated lead outwards then up to J4. Actual solder/insulation clearance must be trialled; the remaining foot bearing must sit flat.

pin_height_jig.note: Loading only. Two annular supports carry the integrated mounting feet at motherboard datumZ0; the central floor stops all pin tips atZ-3.20. Remove before soldering. Equal top heights require equal measured10.70mm pin lengths and sufficient guide retention.

mounting.direction: Screw head and insulating washer beneath motherboard; screw upward through base and PCB; nut directly on supported SHIELD pad above adapter PCB
mounting.note: M3x12 under-head default. Mandatory assumed0.50mm insulating washer,OD8/ID3.2, beneath motherboard; default no top washer. Reference-board bareØ7head overlapsforeigncopper. Insulation dimensions, PCB seating and chassisclearance require physical checks. Topwasher optional only after threadengagement/capreview.14/16mm needshortening orreview. No motherboard countersinking/drilling. Deliberate wire bond is required because underside head is insulated.
mounting.compression_sleeve_note: Optional rigid sleeve/stop would require a reviewed bore variant and measured length equal to motherboard-top-to-PCB-underside height (nominal 5.75). No custom sleeve is required by this default prototype. Verify flat seating and use tested light tightening; plastic creep/retention strength remain unverified.

cap.note: Cosmetic keyed clip-on cover; nut-pocket tongues retain jackpost nuts. Two rear-facing cantilever latches engage open-outboard notches behind front towers. Mounting-nut clearance windows intentionally interrupt lower skirts. This is not the primary cable load attachment. Latch fit, deflection and material fatigue are untested; do not force a tight print.
